specification.candidate_scope: all 737280 original self-branch candidates; raw primary and original-active sensitivity; stable event:branch:pixel IDs
specification.score_pose: creation decision snapshot poses and revision; no final poses, GT poses, GT calibration or GT geometry in feature extraction
specification.evidence: five KF self-branch raw pointmaps; source disjoint means disjoint original image ancestry; raw observations mutually independent is not claimed
specification.rgb_attribution: source 5x5 pointmap patch is warped through the same decision-time relative Sim(3) into evidence predicted rays; depth/angle/confidence/occlusion masks per patch sample; region scores attached to central candidate, not isolated Gaussian photometric responsibility
specification.b8_camera: OLS pinhole surrogate fitted only to current raw predicted pointmap rays and pixel indices; per-candidate angular fit mask; exact predicted-ray KD matching remains primary for cross-view scores
specification.b8_premap: only original-filtered KF candidates strictly older than current candidate; all placed at current decision revision; SH residual plus stored exposure-normalized source RGB; never final PLY
specification.score_direction: higher means more suspicious/redundant; unknown = NaN, never silently zero evidence
specification.aggregation: B6/B7/P1 median across eligible views in the same snapshot; 2view requires >=2 eligible views simultaneously; one-view P1 is a discriminability diagnostic, not permission to REJECT
specification.evaluation_label_primary: creation-pose GT depth proxy using frozen E1 GT views/masks/tolerance and evaluation-only E1 global alignment
specification.unknown_gt_label: exclude ambiguous labels; bad=3; protected normal=1 or 2; report eligible/labeled fractions and labeled bad prevalence
specification.split_limitation: single previously inspected E1 scene, overlapping source images and GT evaluation views; temporal candidate partition is not an untouched independent scene test
specification.threshold_policy: development eligible normal score quantile using higher interpolation, reject strictly > threshold, ties kept; freeze thresholds before temporal-evaluation metrics; no threshold if development normal evidence absent
specification.ranking_metric: average precision (step PR area), tie-block trapezoidal PR-AUC separately; constant score AP equals cohort prevalence
specification.progress_rule: descriptive signal lead only if common temporal-evaluation cohort has >=100 bad and >=100 normal, >=1% raw coverage, P1 AP >= B6 AP +0.02 and >= B7 NCC AP +0.02, plus calibrated global normal retention >=0.99; research-wide GO and repeated-observation admission require additional scenes and >=2-view availability
specification.deferred_policy: lock each cross-view method score at its first eligible actual decision snapshot; no label/score-based choice of revisit; no real admission queue executed
specification.scope: score diagnostic only; no tracking/map/threshold-tuning on held-out RGB or GT; no deletion, matched-budget, online policy efficacy, statistical independence or paper reproduction claim

label_definition: bad=3, protected normal=1/2, unknown=0 excluded; creation proxy has no redundancy subclass

decision.interpretation: pilot score comparison only; preserve unknowns; additional scenes and repeated-view evidence required
